source_papers.identity_scope: Brain 134:3083-3093, DOI 10.1093/brain/awr240. Experimental melody/rhythm/lyric task study, n=17 nonfluent aphasic stroke participants, including a four-person percussion-control comparison. Seven additions match immediate performance, frequency-variance null, basal-ganglia/rhythm interaction and age/lyric effects on PDF pp. 7-10. Previously held R001 remains excluded; no therapy-efficacy promotion.

Frontiers in Human Neuroscience 7:35, DOI 10.3389/fnhum.2013.00035. Fifteen chronic nonfluent aphasic stroke participants in three systematically matched groups of five; six-week treatment. Retained R003 matches non-formulaic production change and R007 the n=10 voice-variance comparison, PDF pp. 6, 8-9. Three clinical_RCT records and one whole-cohort/subgroup count mismatch held.

Brain 145:1354-1367, DOI 10.1093/brain/awab377. Twenty-seven recruited, 26 included with full language tests, left-hemisphere infarct/mild-moderate aphasia; 2-week/4-month longitudinal PCA and fMRI, 22 repeated-scan controls. Eleven additions match PDF pp. 3, 5-8. R001/R002 use abstract shorthand uncorrelated; their existing notes/source passages preserve the significant negative fluency-phonology change correlation, also separately represented by R003. This qualification remains necessary for human review; no claim editing or scientific approval.

Brain Structure and Function 229:2207-2217, DOI 10.1007/s00429-024-02826-z. Twenty-two DTI participants from a 58-person subacute aphasia intervention trial. R011 matches the current long-term discourse-efficiency model null for days since stroke on PDF p. 6, with 5/20-week outcome definition on p. 4. Overall imaging cohort distinguished from available-case regressions.

Frontiers in Neuroscience 16:853169, DOI 10.3389/fnins.2022.853169. Thirty-two chronic left-subcortical stroke participants with history of aphasia and 30 healthy controls; six stroke participants recovered by assessment. Thirteen additions match current cortical thickness/language, tract FA, perfusion subgroup and SVR-LSM-null results, PDF pp. 2-7. Within-patient associations, patient/control contrasts and imaging-to-imaging results remain distinct; source metadata/construct review flags retained.
